title: Increased Criminal Activities
description: Use this service request to report complaints of reoccurring criminal offenses such as burglaries, thefts, and criminal mischief's in a particular neighborhood that have been reported. MUST provide day/time of activity, exact location, and a description of individual(s) involved. Note: If reporting a crime that is occurring or that has just occurred - CALL 9-1-1. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

detailsForm.intro: ***Be advised that this service request is not monitored on a 24-hour basis. If you have an emergency and require immediate assistance, please call 911.***

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for recurring criminal offenses in a particular neighborhood, such as reported burglaries, thefts, or criminal mischief.
actions.why: For recurring criminal offenses in a particular neighborhood, such as reported burglaries, thefts, or criminal mischief. The description calls for days and times, exact location, and a description of involved individuals; the 311 request form asks whether the problem recurs and for information about individuals, vehicles, and times.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Increased Criminal Activities" requests does not apply to a crime occurring now or that has just occurred. If a crime is occurring or has just occurred, then call 911.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Criminal Activities"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Criminal Activities"

actions.tagline: Call 911 to report a crime happening now or just occurred.
actions.why: For a crime that is occurring or has just occurred; the description for "Increased Criminal Activities" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs people to call 9-1-1.

actions.tagline: Consider submitting a 311 request for additional neighborhood patrol.
actions.why: For a request for additional police patrol in a neighborhood or specific Dallas area when you answer No to whether the criminal activity is recurring. The Increased Criminal Activities request form suggests "Increased Police Patrol" for that answer.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Police Patrol"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Police Patrol"
